target.title: feat(mac): redesign Settings window, remove Poltergeist
target.body:
Two changes, as requested: Poltergeist is fully removed from the repo, and the Settings window got the native-forms redesign treatment.

## Poltergeist removal

- Deleted `poltergeist.config.json`, `.watchmanconfig`, `docs/poltergeist.md`, and seven `scripts/poltergeist*` / verification / status scripts.
- Removed the 11 `polter` / `poltergeist:*` script aliases from `package.json`, the `.poltergeist*` gitignore entries, the AGENTS.md workflow bullet, and the Poltergeist progress-marker filter in `scripts/build-mac-debug.sh`.
- Scrubbed instructional docs (`building`, `install`, `testing/tools`, `visualizer`, `playground-testing`, `spec`, `agent-chat`, and more) to point at `./scripts/build-mac-debug.sh` / `pnpm run build:cli` / the plain `peekaboo` binary. Historical run logs and research notes keep their original commands as records.
- Dropped the dead `runPolterPeekaboo` test helper, rebuild-test comments, and the CLI help tip that recommended `polter peekaboo` in every help card.

## Settings redesign

All six tabs now use native macOS grouped forms with no double padding:

- **AI**: seven redundant "X Configuration" sections collapsed into one API Keys list (label left, secure field right, environment-variable status as a compact footnote with an inline "Use Environment" action). Model and Vision pickers are proper labeled rows.
- **Model picker correctness**: the selected model previously rendered blank or as a raw id (`claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`) when the selection came from `~/.peekaboo/config.json` — the config manager briefly classifies configured providers as custom providers at startup, which swapped the built-in catalog entry for a raw-named one, and a `Menu { Picker }` workaround got promoted to a pop-up button that discards custom labels. The catalog is now a static with a pretty-name lookup used by every fallback path, and the menus are plain button menus with explicit checkmarks, so the row always shows "Claude Sonnet 4.5"-style names.
- **Visualizer**: the hand-rolled `IOSToggleStyle` is deleted; everything uses native switches, the oversized header is a standard toggle row, and sliders are single rows with inline values.
- **Shortcuts**: three native `KeyboardShortcuts.Recorder` rows plus a one-line hint, replacing the numbered how-to wall.
- **Permissions**: standard grouped layout around the permission checklist.
- **About**: native `Link`s in a horizontal row, © 2026.

Net: **−222 lines** in the settings code.

## Before / After (dark)

| Tab | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| **AI** | ![ai before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/Peekaboo/pr-assets/settings-redesign/settings-ai-before.png) | ![ai after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/Peekaboo/pr-assets/settings-redesign/settings-ai-after.png) |
| **Visualizer** | ![visualizer before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/Peekaboo/pr-assets/settings-redesign/settings-visualizer-before.png) | ![visualizer after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/Peekaboo/pr-assets/settings-redesign/settings-visualizer-after.png) |
| **Shortcuts** | ![shortcuts before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/Peekaboo/pr-assets/settings-redesign/settings-shortcuts-before.png) | ![shortcuts after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/Peekaboo/pr-assets/settings-redesign/settings-shortcuts-after.png) |
| **Permissions** | ![permissions before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/Peekaboo/pr-assets/settings-redesign/settings-permissions-before.png) | ![permissions after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/Peekaboo/pr-assets/settings-redesign/settings-permissions-after.png) |

Screenshots are live captures of the debug build, hosted on the `pr-assets/settings-redesign` branch.

## Testing

- `./scripts/build-mac-debug.sh` and `pnpm run build:cli` — clean builds
- `pnpm run test:safe` — passing (see CI)
- `pnpm run format` — no changes; `pnpm run lint` — no violations in touched files
- Autoreview (Codex, gpt-5.5): one finding (stale `pnpm run peekaboo` doc command) — fixed; final run clean. The flagged CLI help `polter` tip is also fixed.
- Manual: clicked through every tab in the running app; verified the model menu shows the pretty name for a config-sourced selection, env-var footnotes, switches, recorders, and permission actions render natively.
